package.author: Denis Desbiens
package.description: Free Windows hardware monitor that explains PC health in plain words
package.installationNotes: Aurora asks for administrator rights (UAC) each time it starts, because reading hardware sensors requires them. If they are missing, the installer also adds the .NET 10 runtime and the PawnIO driver (used to read CPU temperatures and motherboard fans).

en-US.author: Denis Desbiens
en-US.description: Free Windows hardware monitor that explains PC health in plain words
en-US.installationNotes: Aurora asks for administrator rights (UAC) each time it starts, because reading hardware sensors requires them. If they are missing, the installer also adds the .NET 10 runtime and the PawnIO driver (used to read CPU temperatures and motherboard fans).
en-US.longDescription:
Aurora watches your PC every second (temperatures, fan speeds, clock speeds, loads and power) and tells you in plain words whether everything is fine, and what to look at when it isn't.
- Health tab that sums up the processor, graphics card, memory, drives and fans in plain language
- In-game overlay with FPS, 1% lows, temperatures and loads, and what limits your frame rate (GPU, CPU or frame cap)
- Fan modes, a cooling test that spots dust build-up over time, and a day-by-day log of changes made to the PC with their measured effect
- Storage tools: byte-for-byte duplicate finder, what takes up space, games not played in months; deletions go to the Recycle Bin
- Windows tab: update advisor and settings that can be restored in one click
- Five themes, French and English interface, optional Stream Deck plugin (separate download)
Aurora is free, with no ads, no account and no telemetry. Optional cosmetic skins are sold separately on auroraapp.ca; every feature stays free.
en-US.name: Aurora

fr-CA.description: Moniteur matériel gratuit pour Windows qui explique la santé du PC en mots simples
fr-CA.installationNotes: Aurora demande les droits administrateur (UAC) à chaque démarrage, parce que la lecture des capteurs les exige. S'ils manquent, l'installeur ajoute aussi le runtime .NET 10 et le pilote PawnIO (températures du processeur et ventilateurs de la carte mère).
fr-CA.longDescription:
Aurora surveille ton PC chaque seconde (températures, ventilateurs, fréquences, charges et consommation) et te dit en mots simples si tout va bien, et quoi regarder quand ça ne va pas.
Overlay de jeu (FPS, 1 % bas, ce qui limite les images), test de refroidissement, journal des changements, doublons et espace disque, onglet Windows réversible, cinq thèmes, en français et en anglais.
Aurora est gratuite, sans publicité, sans compte et sans télémétrie. Des skins décoratifs optionnels sont vendus à part sur auroraapp.ca ; toutes les fonctions restent gratuites.
